authoring_rationale: Class A, deceptive stylistic variation (a quiet change under a surface makeover). One variant is a bulleted sharing summary; the other a friendly prose overview addressed to the member. Under the reformatting, sleep routine notes move from the private list to the items the steward sees. Boundary crossing differs (sleep routine notes cross from member-private into the steward's view) and permission differs (steward read access to those notes). Locatable in the bulleted lists of one variant and in the second and third sentences of the other. Everything else is the same: check-in completion and reminder settings shared; evening reflection entries and meditation session notes private; only the member changes the summary, from the privacy page. Checked that governance_delta_present is reachable from the visible text alone.
